
#Creating RD datasets (for RUR, PUR, GUR)
```{r}
#Import the mask which will be important for masking any unmasked data at this point
BC_Mask <- terra::vect("./raw_data/BC_Buffer/BC_Buffer.shp") %>% terra::project("epsg:3005")

#Import the shapefile we will be using to represent land/the coastline and project to the correct crs/mask to NC
Coastline <- vect("./raw_data/BC_Buffer/GSHHS_f_L1.shp") %>% terra::project("epsg:3005")
Land <- Coastline %>% terra::mask(BC_Mask)

#Load in the prepped RD data 
Urchin_Transects_Filtered <- sf::st_read("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/Urchin_RDensity_Transects_Filtered.shp")
```

#Create red urchin shapefiles
```{r}

selected_species <- "RUR"

filtered_data <- Urchin_Transects_Filtered %>% filter(species == selected_species)

RUR_Year_list <- unique((filtered_data %>% dplyr::filter(species == selected_species))$year)
# Load bathymetry layer
Bathymetry <- terra::rast("./processed_data/ENV_layers/DEM_100.tif")

#For each year in the RUR year list generate RD points, a RD raster, and a map of where RDs were observed
for (i in 1:length(RUR_Year_list)){
  Shapefile_Output <- Shapefile_Creator(filtered_data %>% dplyr::filter(year == RUR_Year_list[i]), Bathymetry, selected_species)
  terra::writeVector(Shapefile_Output, paste0("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RDensity_Points_", RUR_Year_list[i],".shp"), overwrite = TRUE)
}


```

#Create points 
```{r}
#Generate a list of years for which data is available 
RUR_Year_list <- unique((Urchin_Transects_Filtered %>% dplyr::filter(species == "RUR"))$year)

#Load bathymetry layer
Bathymetry <- terra::rast("./processed_data/ENV_layers/DEM_100.tif")

#For each year in the RUR year list generate RD points, a RD raster, and a map of where RDs were observed
for (i in 1:length(RUR_Year_list)){
  RUR_Output <- Point_Creator(Urchin_Transects_Filtered %>% dplyr::filter(year == RUR_Year_list[i]), "RUR", Bathymetry)
  RUR_Count_Points <- RUR_Output[[2]]
  RUR_Raster <- RUR_Output[[1]]
  terra::writeVector(RUR_Count_Points, paste0("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RD_Points_", RUR_Year_list[i],".shp"), overwrite = TRUE)
  terra::writeRaster(RUR_Raster, paste0("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RD_Raster_", RUR_Year_list[i], ".tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  RUR_Pres_Map <- Pres_Map(Land, RUR_Count_Points %>% terra::project(crs(Land)))
  ggsave(paste0("./Plots/Maps/Species_RDensity_Maps/RUR_RD_Map_", RUR_Year_list[i], ".jpeg"), RUR_Pres_Map, units = "mm", width = 120, height = 140)
}

#Do the same for the entire time period 
RUR_Output <- Point_Creator(Urchin_Transects_Filtered, "RUR", Bathymetry)
RUR_Count_Points <- RUR_Output[[2]]
RUR_Raster <- RUR_Output[[1]]
terra::writeVector(RUR_Count_Points, "./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RD_Points.shp", overwrite = TRUE)
terra::writeRaster(RUR_Raster, "./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RD_Raster.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

RUR_Count_Points <- terra::vect("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RD_Points.shp")
RUR_Pres_Map <- Pres_Map(Land, RUR_Count_Points %>% terra::project(crs(Land)))

ggsave("./Plots/Maps/Species_RDensity_Maps/RUR_RD_Map.jpeg", RUR_Pres_Map, units = "mm", width = 120, height = 140)
```

#Plotting ordinal dataset

#BIOMOD Pipeline
```{r}
Land <- terra::vect("./raw_data/BC_Buffer/Land.shp")

Urchin_Transects_Filtered <- sf::st_read("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/Urchin_RDensity_Transects_Filtered.shp")
colnames(Urchin_Transects_Filtered)[4] <- "Year"
colnames(Urchin_Transects_Filtered)[11] <- "Species"


RUR_Transects <- terra::subset(Urchin_Transects_Filtered, Species == "RUR")
RUR_Year_list <- unique(RUR_Transects$Year)

#Set up dataframes to hold 
resp_df <- data.frame(mean = numeric())
env_df <- data.frame(
  ID = numeric(),
  TAlk_10m_mean = numeric(),
  salt_10m_mean = numeric(),
  salt_10m_min = numeric(),
  temp_s_mean = numeric(),
  temp_s_max = numeric(),
  temp_s_min = numeric(),
  temp_10m_mean = numeric(),
  temp_10m_max = numeric(),
  temp_10m_min = numeric(),
  do_10m_mean = numeric(),
  do_10m_min = numeric(),
  Current = numeric(),
  REI = numeric(),
  Rock = numeric(),
  Slope = numeric(),
  Depth = numeric()
)


#Create an empty data frame to store x,y
xy <- data.frame(
  x = numeric(),
  y = numeric()
)


for (i in 1:length(RUR_Year_list)){
  #Load the environmental layers for year i
  env.var <- terra::rast(paste0("./processed_data/ENV_layers/BCCM_Rasters/Predictor_hindcast_climatology_", RUR_Year_list[i], ".tif"))
  
  #Load shapefile for year i 
  resp.var <- terra::vect(paste0("./processed_data/Urchin_RDensity/RUR_RDensity_Points_", RUR_Year_list[i], ".shp"))
  
  #Convert ordinal category to a factor (for summarization in nect step)
  resp.var$density <- factor(resp.var$density, levels = c("Abundant", "Many", "Few", "None"))
  
  #Remove rows where 'density' is 'Null' or NA
  resp.var <- resp.var[!is.na(resp.var$density) & resp.var$density != "Null", ]
  
  # Convert the 'density' factor to numeric (you can assign values based on levels order)
  resp.var$density <- as.numeric(factor(resp.var$density, levels=c("None", "Few", "Many", "Abundant")))
  
  #Rasterize shapefile, using env raster, take average density
  resp_raster <- terra::rasterize(resp.var, env.var, field = "density", fun = "mean") #takes most common density category per cell, creates raster
  
  #Resample shapefile, to env raster
  resp_raster <- terra::resample(resp_raster, env.var) #align resolutions and extents to environmental raster
  
  #Convert raster to point (using as.points) 
  points <- terra::as.points(resp_raster) #now each point has a location and averaged density value 
  
  
  points_df <- as.data.frame(points)
  
  # Convert density to an ordered factor with custom labels
  points_df$mean <- factor(points_df$mean,
                                    levels = c(1,2,3,4),
                                    labels = c("None","Few","Many", "Abundant"),
                                    ordered = TRUE)
  
  #Extract coordinates of shapefile (using geom)
  coordinates <- terra::geom(points, df=TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(x, y)
  
  #Extract environmental variables for these coordinates 
  env_values <- terra::extract(env.var, points)
  
  #Append points_df to resp_df
  resp_df <- rbind(resp_df, points_df)
  
  #Append env_values to env_df
  env_df <- rbind(env_df, env_values)
  
  #Append coordinate to xy dataframe using rbind
  xy <- rbind(xy, coordinates)
}

summary(resp_df)
summary(env_df)

#create full training dataframe 
print("Finished: Create dataframes BY year")

env_df <- env_df[, !(colnames(env_df) %in% c("ID", "temp_s_mean", "salt_10m_mean", "temp_10m_max"))]

#Read in projection layers, and remove the same variables

proj.var <- rast("./processed_data/ENV_layers/BCCM_Rasters/Predictor_Hindcast_Climatologies_2012-2023.tif") 

proj.var <- proj.var[[!names(proj.var) %in% c("temp_s_mean", "salt_10m_mean", "temp_10m_max")]] #remove same variables

names(proj.var)

print("Finished: Running collinearity") 

#Create evaluation dataset using blockCV

#Create final training dataset
RUR_training_data <- cbind(xy, resp_df, env_df) %>% na.omit() #includes all data, lrngth = 2003 observations


#Set the size of spatial blocks based on previously completed autocorrelation analysis
Block_Size <-90000  #CODEEDIT to adjust block size for the species if needed 
#Set the k-value for k-fold cross-validation: number of spatial folds
k <- 10

#Load in hindcast climatology #CODEEDIT select for only the variables I want included in my models
Hindcast_Climatology <- terra::rast("./processed_data/ENV_layers/BCCM_Rasters/Predictor_Hindcast_Climatologies_2012-2023.tif")

Hindcast_Climatology <- terra::subset(Hindcast_Climatology, !(names(Hindcast_Climatology) %in% c("temp_s_mean", "salt_10m_mean", "temp_10m_max")))


#Turn the final training dataset into an sf object
RUR_training_data_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(RUR_training_data, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 3005)

#Set seed
set.seed(157)
#Spatially block based on the optimal size suggested above
RUR_training_blocks <- blockCV::cv_spatial(RUR_training_data_sf, column = "mean", hexagon = FALSE, k = k+1, size = Block_Size, selection = "random", iteration = 200)

RUR_training_data$fold <- RUR_training_blocks$folds_ids
RUR_training_data_sf$fold <- RUR_training_blocks$folds_ids

#Check to see how many  points ended up in each block
Point_summary <- terra::as.data.frame(RUR_training_data) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(fold) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Point_num = dplyr::n())

write.csv(Point_summary, "./Generated_Data/Interim_datasets/RURord_point_summary.csv")

#Check to see how many of each ordinal category is in each fold 
Point_summary <-RUR_training_data %>%
  group_by(fold, mean) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  arrange(fold, desc(mean))

# Summarize the counts
plot_data <- RUR_training_data %>%
  group_by(fold, mean) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(fold), y = count, fill = mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Fold", y = "Count", fill = "Density Category",
       title = "Density Category Counts per Fold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("None" = "#999999", "Few" = "#FFD700", "Many" = "#FFA500", "Abundant" = "#E31A1C")) +
  theme_minimal()

plot

#Create a final evaluation df from the K+1 fold

eval_resp_df <- RUR_evaluation_df$mean
eval_xy <- RUR_evaluation_df %>% dplyr::select(x, y)
eval_env <- RUR_evaluation_df %>% dplyr::select(TAlk_10m_mean, salt_10m_min, temp_s_max, temp_s_min, temp_10m_mean, temp_10m_min, do_10m_mean, do_10m_min, Current, REI, Rock, Slope, Depth)

                                     data.type = c("ordinal"), 
                                     eval.expl.var = eval_env, #SpatRaster without associated data, independent data to evaluate
                                     eval.resp.var = eval_resp_df, #SpatVector without associated data, independent data to evaluate 
                                     eval.resp.xy = eval_xy, #if resp.vect is vector, 2 column matrix of xy coordinates
                                     na.rm = TRUE,
```

```{r}
RC_Map <- function(RC_Layer, Legend_Label, layername, BC) {
  # Compute min and max values for the chosen layer
  vmin <- round(min(RC_Layer[[layername]], na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  vmax <- round(max(RC_Layer[[layername]], na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  
  # Calculate break points for the legend
  breaks <- round(seq(vmin, vmax, length.out = 5), 2)
  labels <- as.character(breaks)
  
  # Build the ggplot
  RC_Plot <- ggplot(BC) +
    geom_sf(data = BC, fill = "#d9d9d9", color = NA) +
    geom_raster(data = RC_Layer, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = .data[[layername]])) +
    coord_sf(crs = st_crs(3005)) +
    xlim(c(515000, 1255000)) +
    ylim(c(340000, 1100000)) +
    annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.5) +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true",
                           pad_x = unit(0.01, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.25, "in"),
                           style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    scale_fill_continuous(
      type = "viridis",
      na.value = NA,
      name = Legend_Label,
      limits = c(vmin - 0.01, vmax + 0.01),
      breaks = breaks,
      labels = labels
    ) +
    xlab(element_blank()) + ylab(element_blank()) +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(1, 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text.align = 0,
      legend.title.align = 0,
      legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
      legend.box.just = "right",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
    )
  
  return(RC_Plot)
}
```

#Null models 
```{r}
gc()

#Create a dataframe of the environment to pull null model training dataset from 
Training_Data <- RUR_training_df  #needs to be a dataframe with xy, resp, env with only TRAINING data 
Testing_Data <- RUR_evaluation_df #needs to be a dataframe with xy, resp, env with only TESTING data 
Survey_Enviro_df <- env_df #includes all environmental data 
Predictor_num <- ncol(env_df)

#Create null models using the same parameters and randomly drawn presence points for the enviro_buffer dataframe (same background points)

#Set up a dataframe to hold all of the evaluation metrics for the null models
Null_metrics <- data.frame(
  full.name = character(),
  merged.by.PA = character(),
  merged.by.run = character(),
  merged.by.algo = character(),
  algo = character(),
  metric.eval = character(),
  cutoff = logical(),
  sensitivity= logical(),
  calibration = numeric(),
  validation = numeric(),
  evaluation = numeric()
)


#Run 1000 null models
for (j in 1:2){
  
  #Perform a random pull from the environmental dataframe for each presence point in the training dataset
  for (i in 1:nrow(Training_Data)) {
    set.seed(313*j + round(46*i))
    randnum <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Survey_Enviro_df)), size = 1)
    Training_Data[i, 4:(3+ Predictor_num)] <- Survey_Enviro_df[randnum,]
    
    train_resp_df <- Training_Data$mean
    train_xy <- Training_Data %>% dplyr::select(x, y)
    train_env <- Training_Data %>% dplyr::select(TAlk_10m_mean, salt_10m_min, temp_s_max, temp_s_min, temp_10m_mean, temp_10m_min, do_10m_mean, do_10m_min, Current, REI, Rock, Slope, Depth)
    
  }
  
  sp <- c('RUR')
  
  #define models to run 
  all_models <- c("GAM") 
  
  #fit my *real* biomod2 models to null TRAINING data, made by for loop above
myBiomodData <- BIOMOD_FormatingData(resp.var = train_resp_df, #as SpatVector without associated data, for a single species
                                     expl.var = train_env, #SpatRaster containing explanatory variables in layers
                                     resp.name = sp, #character corresponding to species name
                                     resp.xy = train_xy, #if resp.var is vector, 2 column matrix associated xy coordinates
                                     dir.name = c('./models_biomod/null_ordinal/RUR'), 
                                     data.type = c("ordinal"), 
                                     #eval.expl.var = eval_env, #SpatRaster without associated data, independent data to evaluate
                                     #eval.resp.var = eval_resp_df, #SpatVector without associated data, independent data to evaluate 
                                     #eval.resp.xy = eval_xy, #if resp.vect is vector, 2 column matrix of xy coordinates
                                     na.rm = TRUE, 
                                     filter.raster = TRUE, #filter points in same cell
                                     seed.val = 1234
) 
opt.d <- bm_ModelingOptions(data.type = 'ordinal', #character corresponding to data type to be used (see below)
                            models = all_models,
                            strategy = 'default',
                            bm.format = myBiomodData)
  
cv <- bm_CrossValidation(bm.format = myBiomodData,
                         strategy = "kfold", #options are random, k-fold, strat, block, env, or user-defined
                         nb.rep = 1, #integer, number of repetitions of CV points to be drawn 
                         k = 10, #number of partitions                                         
                         do.full.models = TRUE #calibrated and validated over the whole dataset (and pseudo-absence datasets) or not
) 
  
  

myBiomodModelOut <- BIOMOD_Modeling(bm.format = myBiomodData,
                                    models = all_models,
                                    CV.strategy = "user.defined",
                                    CV.user.table = cv,
                                    OPT.strategy = "user-defined",
                                    OPT.user = opt.d,
                                    metric.eval = c("F1"),
                                    var.import = 3,
                                    seed.val = 42,
                                    nb.cpu = 14)

EnsembleModelsOut <- BIOMOD_EnsembleModeling(bm.mod= myBiomodModelOut,
                                             models.chosen = 'all', #define models kept, can exclude models here
                                             em.by='all', #chr, way kept models are combined to build ensemble models, see below 
                                             em.algo = c('EMwmean'), #weighted mean by the evaluation metric 
                                             #metric.select = c('F1'), #metric select and threshold determines which single models to keep 
                                             #metric.select.thresh = c(0.45),
                                             #metric.select.dataset = c('evaluation'),
                                             metric.eval= c('F1'),
                                             EMci.alpha = 0.05, #num, significance level to estimate confidence interval
                                             EMwmean.decay ="proportional", # value defining relative importance of weights, discrimate good v bad models
                                             var.import=100) #vect, number of permutations to determine variable importance

  #get model evaluation metrics 
  eval_ensemble <- get_evaluations(EnsembleModelsOut)
  eval_ensemble <- as.data.frame(eval_ensemble)
  
  #add eval_ensemble to empty df of null metrics above
  Null_metrics <- rbind(Null_metrics, eval_ensemble)
  
}
```

```{r}
#read in files

#Format 
#Make a difference between testing and evaluation F1

null$difference <- abs(null$evaluation - null$calibration)

#rename columns
models <- models %>%
  rename("F1 Training" = calibration,
         "F1 Testing" = evaluation, 
         "F1 Difference" = difference)


null <- null %>%
  rename("F1 Training" = calibration,
         "F1 Testing" = evaluation, 
         "F1 Difference" = difference)



#PLot
#Create long-form dataframes for the model and null model metrics for plotting
  Model_metrics_long <- models %>% pivot_longer(cols = c("F1 Training", "F1 Testing", "F1 Difference"), names_to = "Metric", 
                        values_to = "Value") %>% dplyr::select('Metric', 'Value')
  
Model_metrics_long$Metric <- factor(Model_metrics_long$Metric, levels = c("F1 Training", "F1 Testing", "F1 Difference"))
  
Null_metrics_long <- null %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("F1 Training", "F1 Testing", "F1 Difference"),
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>% dplyr::select(Metric, Value)


Null_metrics_long$Metric <- factor(Null_metrics_long$Metric, levels = c("F1 Training", "F1 Testing", "F1 Difference"))
  
  #Plot the model and null model evaluation metrics
  RUR_Eval_Plot <- ggplot() + geom_boxplot(data = Null_metrics_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Metric)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#613f74", "#91B3B6", "#F4E76E", "#EDAF97"), labels = c("F1 Training", "F1 Testing", "F1 Difference")) + 
    stat_summary(data = Model_metrics_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Value), fun.y = mean, geom = "point", colour = "#e6360F", size = 3) + 
    xlab("Evaluation Metric") + ylab("Value") + theme_classic() + 
    guides(x.sec = "axis", y.sec = "axis")+ theme(axis.line.y.left = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "black"), axis.line.y.right = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "black"), axis.line.x.top = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "black"), axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(size = 0.75, color = "black"),axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(), axis.text.x.top = element_blank(), axis.text.y.right = element_blank()) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.justification = "center") + 
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size=8), axis.title = element_text(size = 12))
  
  
  RUR_Eval_Plot
  

  ggsave2(filename = "./Plots/Eval_Plots/Ordinal/RUR_Eval_Plot.jpeg", plot = RUR_Eval_Plot, scale = 1, height = 75, width = 100, units = "mm")
```


#Dataset mapping
```{r}
Land <- terra::vect("./raw_data/BC_Buffer/Land.shp") 
 # Convert land to sf
  land_sf <- st_as_sf(Land)
  
  map_df <- cbind(resp_df, xy) %>% na.omit() 
  
  summary(map_df)

RUR_RA_Map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_sf, fill = "grey80", color = NA) +
  geom_point(
    data = map_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = mean, color = mean),
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    alpha = 0.2,
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Relative Density",
    values = c("None" = NA, "Few" = "#f8b4b2", "Many" = "#e6360F", "Abundant" = "#760b08"),
    na.translate = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Relative Density",
    values = c("None" = "grey50", "Few" = "#f8b4b2", "Many" = "#e6360F", "Abundant" = "#760b08"),
    na.translate = FALSE
  ) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "bl", which_north = "true",
    pad_x = unit(0.01, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.25, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(3005), xlim = c(515000, 1255000), ylim = c(340000, 1100000)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    legend.position = 'top',
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)))



ggsave(
  filename = "./Plots/Maps/Species_RDensity_Maps/RUR_RelativeDataset_Map.png",   # or another path/filename
  plot = RUR_RA_Map,
  width = 10,        
  height = 8,       
  dpi = 300         
)

```



#Response curves
```{r}
#count response curve data 
ord_RUR <- read.csv("./Generated_Data/ES_datasets/RUR_ES_Ordinal.csv")


sp <- c("RUR")
ggdat <- ord_RUR
ggdat$id <- as.factor(ggdat$id)

#Rename 
ggdat <- ggdat %>%
  mutate(
    expl.var.factor = recode(expl.var.factor,
                             "Current" = "Current (m/s)",
                             "Slope" = "Slope (deg)",
                             "Rock" = "Percent Rock",
                             "TAlk_10m_mean" = "Talkbmax (mEq/m³)",
                             "salt_10m_min" = "Sbmin (PSu)",
                             "temp_s_max" = "Tsmax (°C)",
                             "temp_s_min" = "Tsmin (°C)",
                             "temp_10m_mean" = "Tbmean (°C)",
                             "temp_10m_min" = "Tbmin (°C)",
                             "do_10m_mean" = "Oxybmean (mmol/m³)",
                             "do_10m_min" = "Oxybmin (mmol/m³)",
                             "Depth" = "Depth (m)"
    )
  )


ggdat <- ggdat %>%
  mutate(
    expl.name = recode(expl.name,
                       "Current" = "Current (m/s)",
                       "Slope" = "Slope (deg)",
                       "Rock" = "Percent Rock",
                       "TAlk_10m_mean" = "Talkbmax (mEq/m³)",
                       "salt_10m_min" = "Sbmin (PSu)",
                       "temp_s_max" = "Tsmax (°C)",
                       "temp_s_min" = "Tsmin (°C)",
                       "temp_10m_mean" = "Tbmean (°C)",
                       "temp_10m_min" = "Tbmin (°C)",
                       "do_10m_mean" = "Oxybmean (mmol/m³)",
                       "do_10m_min" = "Oxybmin (mmol/m³)",
                       "Depth" = "Depth (m)"
    )
  )



#Plot for most variables (y = 0–10)
p1 <- ggplot(ggdat, aes(x = expl.val, y = pred.val)) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = expl.var.factor),
    method = "loess",
    se = TRUE,
    fill = "grey30",
    color = "#e6360F"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ expl.var.factor,
    scales = "free_x",
    strip.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +  # Set y-axis range to 0–4 without trimming data
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Prob. of Relative Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )

p1

#Save 
ggsave("./Plots/ES_Plots/RUR_ES_Ordinal.png", plot = p1, width = 10, height = 30, dpi = 300)


```



Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
